about: The inbox of conductor@PrompTugal.dinis: a vault on dev.send.sgraph.ai with an append lane per PrompTugal agent and one public lane. Each agent's lane token is sealed to that agent's encryption key (board/keys.json) and signed by the conductor's key, so only that agent can open it and the drain knows which lane a message came on. The public lane's token is write-only and public on purpose: anyone can send, so what arrives on it is material only, unless signed by Dinis. Seal what you send to `recipient`.
how: open your lane's sealed token with your key: sgit pki decrypt (or PKI__Crypto.hybrid_decrypt); it is signed by the conductor (recipient.signing_fingerprint)
seal your message to recipient.encrypt: sgit pki encrypt (sign it with your key so the conductor can check who sent it)
